studiostu·di·o · noun · the other door of Kashkoul

The same house where the Academy teaches the oud and the ney — rented, by the hour, to anyone with something to record. A podcast, a song, a product, a talk. You bring the idea; the room is already lit. نفس البيت الذي تُدرَّس فيه الموسيقى — تستأجره بالساعة لتسجّل ما تريد.

How it works

Three steps.
No forms.

01

Message us

Date, rough hours, what you're making. WhatsApp is fastest; we answer the same day.

02

We dress the set

Tell us the corner and send a reference. It'll be lit and framed before you arrive.

03

Walk in, press record

Coffee in the kitchen, balcony open. Running over? If the next slot is free, it's yours.
